name: kinpress
description: Make a wedding seating chart from a guest list, as a PDF or a printed board.

interface.longDescription:
Kinpress turns your guest list and table plan into an 18x24 inch wedding seating chart. See it in the chat and download the PDF.

Want it printed? Kinpress prints it on foam board and delivers it to your door in the US. Choose "Get it printed and shipped", then leave your e-mail and event date.

Guest names are used only for your chart and deleted after 7 days unless you order.

One board holds up to 500 guests and 60 tables, in Latin or Cyrillic letters.
defaultPrompt: Make a seating chart from this guest list.
Turn my table plan into an 18x24 seating chart.
Get my wedding seating chart printed and delivered.

positive.description: A small wedding with named tables. All names are fictional.
positive.prompt: Use Kinpress to make a seating chart for Elena & Mark, June 14, 2027. Head Table: Ana Kim, Ben Lee. Table 2: Carla Patel, Daniel Rossi, Fiona Sato.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_seating_chart with couple 'Elena & Mark', date 'June 14, 2027' and two tables with those five names, spelled exactly. The card shows a chart preview, '5 guests, 2 tables', a 'Get it printed and shipped' button and a free PDF link. The reply gives the counts and does not repeat the guest list.

positive.description: A style request. All names are fictional.
positive.prompt: Use Kinpress to make a sage green seating chart for Priya & Sam. Table 1: Nora Young, Oscar Vargas. Table 2: Rosa Walker, Umar Zhang.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_seating_chart with style 'sage'. The card has a green ribbon at the top and shows a chart in the sage style, with 4 guests at 2 tables.

positive.description: Accented names must be kept exactly. All names are fictional.
positive.prompt: Make a Kinpress seating chart for Zoë & José. Table 1: Björn Núñez, Łukasz Wójcik, Анна Иванова.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_seating_chart and passes the names unchanged. The PDF contains each name with its accents, and the Cyrillic name in Cyrillic.

positive.description: An edit after a chart exists. All names are fictional.
positive.prompt: Use Kinpress to make a seating chart for Ana & Tom. Table 1: Ben Lee, Cy Fay. Table 2: Di Sato. Then move Cy Fay to Table 2.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_seating_chart with the full list and Cy Fay at Table 2. In this one message it usually makes one call with the move already applied. The card shows 3 guests at 2 tables, and the chart has Cy Fay at Table 2.

positive.description: Asking for a printed board. All names are fictional. The order page takes an e-mail and event date; no payment is taken.
positive.prompt: I need my wedding seating chart printed on a board and delivered. Elena & Mark. Table 1: Ana Kim, Ben Lee. Table 2: Cy Fay.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_seating_chart. The 'Get it printed and shipped' button opens kinpress.datacleave.com/order, which shows the chart, the price, US only, and a request form. No payment is taken in ChatGPT or on the form.

negative.description: Asks for advice, with no list and no chart wanted. Kinpress must not be called.
negative.prompt: What is the etiquette for seating divorced parents at a wedding?

negative.description: Invitations are out of scope. Kinpress must not be called.
negative.prompt: Write the wording for my wedding invitations.

negative.description: A classroom plan is out of scope. Kinpress must not be called.
negative.prompt: Make a seating plan for my 5th grade classroom of 24 students.

review.commerce_description: Kinpress sells a physical product: a printed foam board, delivered in the US. Nothing is sold or paid for in ChatGPT. The button opens a request form on kinpress.datacleave.com (e-mail and event date). We reply by e-mail with a delivery date and an invoice, and the buyer pays through the invoice provider on its own site. The PDF is complete without any order.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: wedding seating charts as a PDF or a printed board.
